output.reason: [ev-3ab1e090dc9b] says only that the source-watcher controller was added to the Flux distribution. It does not say whether the controller is installed by default on existing installs or upgrades, or whether it is optional. The surrounding changelog items [ev-2a1f31a924a0] and [ev-ca5d9cebd770] don't settle this either. The proposed statement itself says the evidence "states no operational consequence". That makes the consequence undetermined, not a positive "none". To decide between none and behavior-change, the upgrade guide or bootstrap/install docs would need to say whether source-watcher is deployed by default.
